g.text: 以工业为根 · 以系统为骨 · 以智能为魂
Where the factory floor meets the reasoning layer

text.tspan: began in mechanical and vehicle engineering — a discipline
that instils respect for physical constraints, engineering
tolerance, and the weight of a real manufacturing process.
A pivot into knowledge management, NLP, and knowledge
graphs surfaced a more fundamental question:
How does industrial knowledge get structured, organized,
and reused — and ultimately put to work by intelligent systems?
I now operate at the seam between OT and IT: fluent in the
realities of the shop floor, capable of architecting the software
backbone, and able to land AI methods inside genuine settings.
Integration is only the starting line. Whether something can
be built, and whether it deserves to be built, are distinct
questions. The first is answered by capability. The second,
by taste.

g.text: W H A T I C A R E A B O U T

text.tspan: Locating room inside constraints, structure inside complexity,
and the abstractions worth preserving inside repetition.
Defining the problem where no one asked, then carrying it
through to a result that holds.
What remains after reading widely, building for years, and
cutting ruthlessly. Code is material; the system is the work.
Placing the technology inside real constraints and asking
whose actual problem it solved.
Neither reverence nor avoidance. I deploy AI in live environments —
inside messy data, entrenched habits, and organizational inertia.
My interest lies not in benchmark deltas, but in whether it spares
a specific person one repetitive task, or surfaces a relationship
that was previously invisible.

text.textPath: “ AI amplifies judgment; it does not replace it. ”

text.tspan: Taking the black box apart until model behavior becomes
legible, debuggable, and worthy of trust.

g.text: S E L E C T E D B U I L D S
From the one who does the work — to the one who defines how the work is done.
长 期 主 义 · 复 利 · 成 长
